theorem valuation_powerSeries_differentiableOn {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    {a : ℕ → ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ha : ∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ C * (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ k) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => ∑' k, a k * z ^ k)
      (ball 0 (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)))

theorem valuation_powerSeries_differentiableOn {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    {a : ℕ → ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ha : ∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ C * (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ k) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => ∑' k, a k * z ^ k)
      (ball 0 (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  intro z hz
  have hz' : ‖z‖ < Real.sqrt (p : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz
  obtain ⟨R, hzR, hRp⟩ := exists_between hz'
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := (norm_nonneg z).trans hzR.le
  have hd := geometric_series_differentiableOn hC (by positivity) hR ha
    (inverse_sqrt_mul_lt_one hp hRp)
  have hmem : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R := by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hzR
  exact (hd.differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableWithinAt

      quantizationCenteredGaussianIntegrand hW T ℓ (tracePoint η t)) (𝓝[>] 0)

  have hη := Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  apply tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun t : ℝ => C * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹)
  · filter_upwards [hη] with η hη
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>

    exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [hη] with η hη

by

    unfold ccmFiniteBlock

/-! ## The rigidity theorem -/

/-- **Prime-measure rigidity for finite perturbations.** If the restricted Weil operator with
finitely many prime weights changed (distinct scales `x i > 1`, weights `w i`) has nonnegative
ground energy at every aperture, then the Riemann hypothesis holds and every weight is zero. -/

source_arguments.name: RHTower.WeilDeletion.riemannHypothesis_and_weights_zero_of_finiteFamily_nonneg
source_arguments.statement:
theorem riemannHypothesis_and_weights_zero_of_finiteFamily_nonneg (P : FinitePrimePerturbation k)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.x)
    (hpos : ∀ a : SuzukiPositiveAperture, 0 ≤ (finiteFamily P).energy a) :
    RiemannHypothesis ∧ ∀ i, P.w i = 0
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem riemannHypothesis_and_weights_zero_of_finiteFamily_nonneg (P : FinitePrimePerturbation k)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.x)
    (hpos : ∀ a : SuzukiPositiveAperture, 0 ≤ (finiteFamily P).energy a) :
    RiemannHypothesis ∧ ∀ i, P.w i = 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hRH : RiemannHypothesis := by
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_finiteFamily_energy_neg_of_not_riemannHypothesis P h
    linarith [hpos a]
  refine ⟨hRH, ?_⟩
  have hreal := xiSpectralPoint_im_eq_zero_of_riemannHypothesis hRH
  have hprof : ∀ ζ : ℝ, perturbationProfile P ζ ≤ 0 := by
    intro ζ₀
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hev : ∀ᶠ ζ in 𝓝 ζ₀, 0 < perturbationProfile P ζ :=
      ((continuous_perturbationProfile P).tendsto ζ₀).eventually (lt_mem_nhds hcon)
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hev
    obtain ⟨ζ, d, hζ, hd, hgap⟩ := exists_gap_frequency hreal ζ₀ hη
    have h1 := perturbationProfile_nonpos_of_gap hreal P hpos hd hgap
    have h2 := hball (by rwa [Real.dist_eq])
    linarith
  have hzero := cosineSum_coeff_eq_zero_of_nonpos Finset.univ
    (fun i => P.w i * (2 / Real.sqrt (P.x i))) (fun i => Real.log (P.x i))
    (fun i _ => Real.log_pos (P.one_lt i))
    (fun i _ j _ h => hinj (Real.log_injOn_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt i]))
      (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt j])) h))
    (fun t => by
      have := hprof t
      unfold perturbationProfile at this
      simp only [mul_comm t] at this
      exact this)
  intro i
  have h := hzero i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hsx : 0 < 2 / Real.sqrt (P.x i) := by
    have : 0 < Real.sqrt (P.x i) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt i])
    positivity
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right hsx.ne'

/-- **Prime-measure rigidity, both directions.** The finitely perturbed restricted Weil operator is
nonnegative at every aperture if and only if the Riemann hypothesis holds and no weight was
changed. -/

    (P : CountablePrimePerturbation) (hinj : Function.Injective P.x)
    (hpos : ∀ a : SuzukiPositiveAperture, 0 ≤ (countableFamily P).energy a) :
    RiemannHypothesis ∧ ∀ n, P.w n = 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hRH : RiemannHypothesis := by
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_countableFamily_energy_neg_of_not_riemannHypothesis P h
    linarith [hpos a]
  refine ⟨hRH, ?_⟩
  have hreal := xiSpectralPoint_im_eq_zero_of_riemannHypothesis hRH
  have hprof : ∀ ζ : ℝ, countableProfile P ζ ≤ 0 := by
    intro ζ₀
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hev : ∀ᶠ ζ in 𝓝 ζ₀, 0 < countableProfile P ζ :=
      ((continuous_countableProfile P).tendsto ζ₀).eventually (lt_mem_nhds hcon)
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hev
    obtain ⟨ζ, d, hζ, hd, hgap⟩ := exists_gap_frequency hreal ζ₀ hη
    have h1 := countableProfile_nonpos_of_gap hreal P hpos hd hgap
    have h2 := hball (by rwa [Real.dist_eq])
    linarith
  have hc : Summable fun n => |P.w n * (2 / Real.sqrt (P.x n))| := by
    refine P.budget_summable.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (two_div_sqrt_pos P n)]
  have hzero := cosineSeries_coeff_eq_zero_of_nonpos
    (fun n => P.w n * (2 / Real.sqrt (P.x n))) (fun n => Real.log (P.x n))
    (fun n => Real.log_pos (P.one_lt n))
    (fun i j h => hinj (Real.log_injOn_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt i]))
      (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt j])) h))
    hc
    (fun t => by
      have := hprof t
      unfold countableProfile at this
      simp only [mul_comm t] at this
      exact this)
  intro n
  have h := hzero n
  have hsx : 0 < 2 / Real.sqrt (P.x n) := by
    have : 0 < Real.sqrt (P.x n) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt n])
    positivity
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right hsx.ne'

Fix n and T. Shift the entire-in-strip integrand

    n^(s-1/2) A(s) exp((s-1/2)^2/T^2)

from Re(s)=1/2+eta to3/2. No pole remains. Polynomial bounds multiplied
by exp(-y^2/T^2) kill both horizontal edges as |y| tends to infinity.
Then let eta decrease to zero; the uniform radial majorants justify
dominated convergence. With the dt normalization, both vertical integrals
are equal. On the right line, interchange the absolutely convergent
Dirichlet series and integral, dominated by

    n exp(1/T^2) sum_m |u_m| m^(-3/2) exp(-t^2/T^2).

The Gaussian Fourier integral now gives the exact absolutely convergent sum

    B_n(T) = n sum_(m>=1) u_m m^(-3/2)
      exp(1/T^2 - (T log(n/m) + 2/T)^2/4)
           = sum_(m>=1) (u_m/sqrt(m))
               exp(-T^2 log(n/m)^2/4).

The first representation, not a presumed critical absolute series, pays
the limit. For T>=1 each summand is bounded in modulus by
e*n*|u_m|*m^(-3/2). Its pointwise limit is zero for m!=n and u_n/sqrt(n)
for m=n. Dominated convergence for this summable majorant proves assertion1.
The second representation is an exact simplification, not an unweighted
boundary Dirichlet expansion. In particular no T-dependent critical
truncation or exchange with a boundary limit is hidden here.

all distinct log frequencies have exponentially vanishing cross terms.

bound for integral |A|^2=2E(T)/(T sqrt(pi)). This proves assertion2,

/-- Integer mode centered on the odd-dimensional packet `{-N,...,N}`. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredMode (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℤ :=
  (i.val : ℤ) - N

/-- The clock of the published finite matrix.  It is dimensionless, exactly as the denominator
`i-j` in CCM equation (5.2). -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredClock (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  ccmPublishedCenteredMode N i

/-- Physical Fourier frequency `πn/a = 2πn/L`, where `L=2a`. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi * ccmPublishedCenteredClock N i / a

/-- Actual published off-diagonal source coordinate at a centered mode. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredSource (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  -(1 / Real.pi) *
    ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilPairing a
      (fun h => Real.sin (ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i * h))

/-- Actual published diagonal coordinate: the restricted Weil value of
`2(1-h/(2a)) cos(πnh/a)`. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredDiagonal (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilPairing a
    (fun h =>
      2 * (1 - h / (2 * a)) *
        Real.cos (ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i * h))

/-- The exact finite restricted-Weil matrix in the centered Fourier packet at physical `a > 0`,
with a totalized algebraic extension to every real `a`. -/
def ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    Matrix (Fin (2 * N + 1)) (Fin (2 * N + 1)) ℝ :=
  ccmDividedDifferenceMatrix
    (ccmPublishedCenteredClock N)
    (ccmPublishedCenteredSource a N)
    (ccmPublishedCenteredDiagonal a N)

/-- Source-lock identification with the pre-existing published coefficient. -/
theorem ccmPublishedCenteredSource_eq_sourceSineCoefficient

    (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) :
    ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix a N i i =

  simp [ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix, ccmDividedDifferenceMatrix]

open Complex Filter Topology

namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

private theorem sum_Icc_one_eq_range {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (f : ℕ → A) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + 1) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]

/-- The two existing definitions use exactly the same truncated logarithm. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) :
    forwardCoeff lam = WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff lam := by
  unfold forwardCoeff WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff
  congr 1
  funext n
  simp only [logZetaCoeff, IntegerMassRigidity.lamLog]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.ofReal_div]

/-- Ordinary harmonic convergence after centering at the literal pole residue. -/
theorem exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ L : ℂ, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      (forwardCoeff lam n - WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1) / n)
        atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := WeilWorkSettledPhase.centered_forward_dirichletConvergesAt
    hW (s := 1) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨L, hL.congr fun N => ?_⟩
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  simp [dirichletPartialSum, Complex.cpow_neg_one, forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, div_eq_mul_inv]

/-- The harmonic weight has leading coefficient one. -/
theorem tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (1 : ℝ) / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log.div_atTop hlog).add_const 1
  simp only [zero_add] at ht
  refine ht.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hlog.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with N hN
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  have hh : (harmonic N : ℝ) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) := by
    simp [harmonic, one_div]
  rw [hh]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  field_simp
  ring

private theorem mean_of_centered {f : ℕ → ℝ} {B L : ℝ}
    (h : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (f n - B) / n)
      atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 B) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (h.div_atTop hlog).add (tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log.const_mul B)
  simp only [mul_one, zero_add] at ht
  apply ht.congr
  intro N
  simp only [sub_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [mul_one_div]
  ring

/-- Both coordinates of the actual logarithmic first mean equal the residue. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_harmonic_mean {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).re / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).re) ∧
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).im / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).im) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit hW
  constructor
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.re)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.re_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.sub_re] using ht
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.im)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.im_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.sub_im] using ht

    (ccmRestrictedWeilBoundedRemainder_isSelfAdjoint a), hrem]

/-! ## The rigidity theorem -/

/-- **Prime-measure rigidity for finite perturbations.** If the restricted Weil operator with
finitely many prime weights changed (distinct scales `x i > 1`, weights `w i`) has nonnegative
ground energy at every aperture, then the Riemann hypothesis holds and every weight is zero. -/
theorem riemannHypothesis_and_weights_zero_of_finiteFamily_nonneg (P : FinitePrimePerturbation k)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P.x)
    (hpos : ∀ a : SuzukiPositiveAperture, 0 ≤ (finiteFamily P).energy a) :
    RiemannHypothesis ∧ ∀ i, P.w i = 0 := by
  have hRH : RiemannHypothesis := by
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_finiteFamily_energy_neg_of_not_riemannHypothesis P h
    linarith [hpos a]
  refine ⟨hRH, ?_⟩
  have hreal := xiSpectralPoint_im_eq_zero_of_riemannHypothesis hRH
  have hprof : ∀ ζ : ℝ, perturbationProfile P ζ ≤ 0 := by
    intro ζ₀

emannHypothesis := by
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_finiteFamily_energy_neg_of_not_riemannHypothesis P h
    linarith [hpos a]
  refine ⟨hRH, ?_⟩
  have hreal := xiSpectralPoint_im_eq_zero_of_riemannHypothesis hRH
  have hprof : ∀ ζ : ℝ, perturbationProfile P ζ ≤ 0 := by
    intro ζ₀
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hev : ∀ᶠ ζ in 𝓝 ζ₀, 0 < perturbationProfile P ζ :=
      ((continuous_perturbationProfile P).tendsto ζ₀).eventually (lt_mem_nhds hcon)
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hev
    obtain ⟨ζ, d, hζ, hd, hgap⟩ := exists_gap_frequency hreal ζ₀ hη
    have h1 := perturbationProfile_nonpos_of_gap hreal P hpos hd hgap
    have h2 := hball (by rwa [Real.dist_eq])
    linarith
  have hzero := cosineSum_coeff_eq_zero_of_nonpos Finset.univ
    (fun i => P.w i * (2 / Real.sqrt (P.x i))) (fun i => Real.log (P.x i))
    (fun i _ => Real.log_pos (P.one_lt i))
    (fun i _ j _ h => hinj (Real.log_injOn_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt i]))
      (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt j])) h))
    (fun t => by
      have := hprof t
      unfold perturbationProfile at this
      simp only [mul_comm t] at this
      exact this)
  intro i
  have h := hzero i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hsx : 0 < 2 / Real.sqrt (P.x i) := by
    have : 0 < Real.sqrt (P.x i) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [P.one_lt i])
    positivity
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right hsx.ne'

/-- **Prime-measure rigidity, both directions.** The finitely perturbed restricted Weil operator is
nonnegative at every aperture if and only if the Riemann hypothesis holds and no weight was
changed. -/
theorem finiteFamily_nonneg_iff (P : FinitePrimePerturbation k) (hinj : Function.Injective P.x) :
    (∀ a : SuzukiPositiveAperture, 0 ≤ (finiteFamily P).energy a) ↔
      RiemannHypothesis ∧ ∀ i, P.w i = 0 := by
  constructor
  · exact riemannHypothesis_and_weights_zero_of_finiteFamily_nonneg P hinj
  · rintro ⟨hRH, hw⟩ a
    rw [finiteFamily_energy_eq_of_weights_zero P hw]
    exact ccmRestrictedWeilGroundEnergy_nonneg_of_riemannHypothesis hRH a

/-!
# One literal parity pole per aperture decides RH, and Weil-positive supersystems force RH

The restricted Weil quadratic on the two literal pole vectors `e^{±x/2}` of the aperture `[−a,a]`
has parity energies `2(A + rC)`, `r = ±1`, where `A` is the diagonal and `C` the cross entry. RH is
equivalent to nonnegativity of both at every aperture (`riemannHypothesis_iff_parityPole_nonneg`).

* **One parity suffices** (`riemannHypothesis_iff_evenParityPole_nonneg`,
  `riemannHypothesis_iff_oddParityPole_nonneg`). The even energy bounds the integrated Chebyshev
  deficit `D(2a)` from below by `−B e^a`, the odd energy bounds it from above. Either one-sided bound
  gives RH by Landau's theorem (`riemannHypothesis_of_logChebyshevDeficitPrimitive_ge`,
  `riemannHypothesis_of_logChebyshevDeficitPrimitive_le`).
* **Supersystems** (`riemannHypothesis_of_evenParityPole_supersystem`). Every visible prime atom
  `n ≤ e^{2a}` acts on the even pole with the nonnegative energy
  `2(2(e^a/n − e^{−a}) + (2a − log n)(1 + 1/n))`. So enlarging the weights above `Λ` can only lower
  the even-pole energy. If a weight system `λ ≥ Λ` has nonnegative even-pole Weil energy at every
  aperture, then so does `Λ`, and RH holds.

The supersystem theorem is the Landau step of order rigidity: a Weil-positive completion of ζ's
archimedean datum that majorizes the von Mangoldt weights forces RH.
-/

/-! ## One-sided deficit bounds from a single parity -/

theorem ccmPoleIntegratedChebyshevDeficit_ge_of_evenParity (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture)
    (h : 0 ≤ ccmRestrictedWeilSourceQuadratic a (ccmPolarParityFormVector a 1)) :
    -(ccmWeilPoleUniformDeficitBound * Real.exp a.1) ≤ ccmPoleIntegratedChebyshevDeficit a := by
  rw [ccmWeilPoleCompression_parity_energy a (Or.inl rfl)] at h
  have hd := abs_le.mp (abs_integratedChebyshevDeficit_sub_weilPoleCross_le a)
  have hA := abs_le.mp (abs_ccmWeilPoleDiagonal_le a)
  have hB := ccmGammaPoleCrossBoundaryMass_le a
  have ha := a.property
  have he : 1 ≤ Real.exp a.1 := Real.one_le_exp ha.le
  have hae : a.1 ≤ Real.exp a.1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp a.1]
  have hC : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.log 2 + Real.pi + 1 := by positivity
  have hK : 0 ≤ |-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - Real.log (2 * Real.pi)| + Real.log 4 + 5 := by
    positivity
  have hBC := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hC
  have hKC := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hae hK
  unfold ccmWeilPoleUniformDeficitBound
  nlinarith

theorem ccmPoleIntegratedChebyshevDeficit_le_of_oddParity (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture)
    (h : 0 ≤ ccmRestrictedWeilSourceQuadratic a (ccmPolarParityFormVector a (-1))) :
    ccmPoleIntegratedChebyshevDeficit a ≤ ccmWeilPoleUniformDeficitBound * Real.exp a.1 := by
  rw [ccmWeilPoleCompression_parity_energy a (Or.inr rfl)] at h
  have hd := abs_le.mp (abs_integratedChebyshevDeficit_sub_weilPoleCross_le a)

/-- The deficit primitive at `T > 0` is the aperture deficit at `a = T/2`. -/
private theorem deficitPrimitive_eq_aperture {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    ccmLogChebyshevDeficitPrimitive T =
      ccmPoleIntegratedChebyshevDeficit ⟨T / 2, by linarith⟩ := by
  rw [ccmPoleIntegratedChebyshevDeficit_eq_logPrimitive]
  congr 1
  change T = 2 * (T / 2)
  ring

/-! ## One parity pole decides RH -/

/-- **Even parity pole.** Nonnegative Weil energy of `e^{x/2} + e^{−x/2}` on every aperture forces
RH. -/
theorem riemannHypothesis_of_evenParityPole_nonneg
    (h : ∀ a : SuzukiPositiveAperture,
      0 ≤ ccmRestrictedWeilSourceQuadratic a (ccmPolarParityFormVector a 1)) :
    RiemannHypothesis := by
  refine riemannHypothesis_of_logChebyshevDeficitPrimitive_ge
    (B := ccmWeilPoleUniformDeficitBound) fun T hT => ?_
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hT with h0 | hpos
  · rw [← h0, ccmLogChebyshevDeficitPrimitive, intervalIntegral.integral_same]
    have := ccmWeilPoleUniformDeficitBound_pos
    have := Real.exp_pos (0 / 2 : ℝ)
    nlinarith
  · rw [deficitPrimitive_eq_aperture hpos]

/-!
# A Weil-positive system with summable deficit below `Λ` is `Λ`

**Theorem** (`eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_summable_deficit`, unconditional). If `lam` is
Weil-positive with the pole term (`WeilPositiveFull`) and its deficit below `Λ` is summable,
`Σ_n (Λ(n) − lam(n))⁺ n^{−1/2} < ∞`, then `lam(n) = Λ(n)` for all `n ≥ 2`. Nothing is assumed about
the excess `(lam − Λ)⁺`.

This contains upward rigidity (`eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_ge`, zero deficit) and
summable rigidity (`eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositive_of_summable_sub`). It also gives eventual upward
rigidity (`eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_eventually_ge`): finitely many exceptions below `Λ`
are allowed a priori and cannot occur.

**The test.** The comb `f = Σ_{j<M} Φχ_L(· − j)` of truncated Riemann kernels (`combRiemannKernel`).
- Its transform is `(Σ_j e^{izj}) û(z)`, so on the zeros its zero side is at most
  `(M e^{M/2})²` times the near-radical energy of `Φχ_L`, which tends to `0`.
- Its autocorrelation `k(y) = Σ_{i,j<M} K_L(y + j − i)` (`combAutocorr_eq_sum`) is a discrete triangle:
  - `0 ≤ k ≤ k(0)` (`combAutocorr_le_zero`);
  - `k(0) ≤ 3CM` by a lattice sum (`combAutocorr_zero_le`);
  - `k(y) ≥ (M − ⌊y⌋) m²` for `y ≥ 0`, with `m = min_{[−1,1]} Φ` (`combAutocorr_ge`).

**The argument.** Write `a = (lam − Λ)/√n = a⁺ − a⁻`. Positivity gives `Σ a (k(log n) + k(−log n)) ≤ ‖W‖ ≤ 1`.
- The deficit costs at most `2k(0) Σ a⁻ ≤ 6CM·D`.
- The excess below `N` earns at least `(M/2) m² Σ_{n<N} a⁺(n)` once `M = 2N + 2`.
- Dividing by `M` bounds every partial sum of the excess, so `lam − Λ ∈ ℓ¹(n^{−1/2})`. Summable
  rigidity then forces `lam = Λ`.

**Corollary** (`riemannHypothesis_iff_exists_weilPositiveFull_summable_deficit`). RH holds iff some
full-cone Weil-positive `lam` has summable deficit below `Λ`.

**Consequence for producers.** A Weil-positive system other than `Λ` has infinite deficit below `Λ`
(this module), and it also exceeds `Λ` somewhere (`eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_le`).
-/

/-! ## A lattice sum -/

theorem exp_neg_two_abs_natCast (n : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (-(2 * |((n : ℤ) : ℝ)|)) = Real.exp (-2) ^ n := by
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; push_cast; rw [abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]; ring_nf

theorem exp_neg_two_abs_negSucc (n : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (-(2 * |((-((n : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)|)) = Real.exp (-2) * Real.exp (-2) ^ n := by
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]; push_cast
  rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; ring_nf

theorem hasSum_int_exp_neg_two_abs :
    HasSum (fun d : ℤ => Real.exp (-(2 * |(d : ℝ)|)))
      ((1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ + Real.exp (-2) * (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹) := by
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-2) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hr1 : Real.exp (-2) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(2 * |((n : ℤ) : ℝ)|))) (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ :=
    (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1).congr_fun fun n => exp_neg_two_abs_natCast n
  have h2 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(2 * |((-((n : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)|)))
      (Real.exp (-2) * (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹) :=
    ((hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1).mul_left (Real.exp (-2))).congr_fun
      fun n => exp_neg_two_abs_negSucc n
  exact HasSum.of_nat_of_neg_add_one h1 h2

theorem summable_int_exp_neg_two_abs : Summable fun d : ℤ => Real.exp (-(2 * |(d : ℝ)|)) :=
  hasSum_int_exp_neg_two_abs.summable

theorem tsum_int_exp_neg_two_abs_le : ∑' d : ℤ, Real.exp (-(2 * |(d : ℝ)|)) ≤ 3 := by
  rw [hasSum_int_exp_neg_two_abs.tsum_eq]
  have hr1 : Real.exp (-2) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hr3 : Real.exp (-2) ≤ 1 / 3 := by
    have h2 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 : ℝ); linarith
    rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_le_comm₀ (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)]; linarith
  have hden : 0 < 1 - Real.exp (-2) := by linarith
  have hinv : (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ ≤ 3 / 2 := by
    rw [inv_le_comm₀ hden (by norm_num)]; linarith
  have hinv0 : 0 ≤ (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hden.le
  calc (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ + Real.exp (-2) * (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹
      = (1 + Real.exp (-2)) * (1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ := by ring
    _ ≤ (1 + 1 / 3) * (3 / 2) := mul_le_mul (by linarith) hinv hinv0 (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 3 := by norm_num

/-- `Σ_{j < M} e^{−2|j − i|} ≤ 3`. -/
theorem sum_range_exp_neg_two_abs_le (i M : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, Real.exp (-(2 * |(j : ℝ) - i|)) ≤ 3 := by
  have hs := summable_int_exp_neg_two_abs
  have hle := tsum_int_exp_neg_two_abs_le
  set g : ℕ → ℤ := fun j => (j : ℤ) - i with hg
  have hinj : Set.InjOn g ↑(Finset.range M) := by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    simp only [hg] at hab
    exact_mod_cast (sub_left_inj.mp hab)

source_arguments.name: RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic.tendsto_coneDeviation_harmonic_pole
source_arguments.statement:
theorem tendsto_coneDeviation_harmonic_pole {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam n / n) atTop (𝓝 (sourcePoleNumerator hW 1).re)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem tendsto_coneDeviation_harmonic_pole {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam n / n) atTop (𝓝 (sourcePoleNumerator hW 1).re)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let v : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0
  let b : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => WeilHerglotz.lamC lam (n + 1) - 1
  have hL := tendsto_dirichletSum (centered_source_dirichletConvergesAt hW (s := 1) (by norm_num))
  have hc : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      (v (n + 1) - 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (dirichletSum b 1).re) := by
    have ht (n : ℕ) : ((v (n + 1) : ℂ) - 1) *
        ((((n : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (-(1 : ℂ))) =
        (((v (n + 1) - 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [Complex.cpow_neg_one]
      push_cast
      rfl
    have hreal := Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _ |>.comp hL
    refine hreal.congr fun N => ?_
    change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ((v (n + 1) : ℂ) - 1) *
      ((((n : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (-(1 : ℂ)))).re = _
    simp_rw [ht]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_sum]
    rfl
  have hh : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1)) atTop
      (𝓝 Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) := by
    have ht := Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    refine ht.congr fun N => ?_
    simp [harmonic, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, one_div]
  have hdev := ((hc.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).add hh).sub tendsto_vonMangoldt_harmonicWeighted
  have heL : ((dirichletSum b 1).re + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) -
      (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + mertensAbelTail) = (sourcePoleNumerator hW 1).re := by
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [centered_source_dirichletSum_one hW, mertensAbelTail_eq]
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.re_ofNat, Complex.im_ofNat, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    ring
  rw [heL] at hdev
  have hdev' : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop
      (𝓝 (sourcePoleNumerator hW 1).re) := by
    refine hdev.congr fun N => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    have hterm (n : ℕ) : WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) =
        (v (n + 1) - 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) -
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      have heq : WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam (n + 1) =
          v (n + 1) - ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n + 1) := by
        by_cases hn : 2 ≤ n + 1
        · simp [v, WeilOneSided.coneDeviation, hn]
        · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
          subst n
          simp [v, WeilOneSided.coneDeviation]
      rw [heq]
      ring
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    ring
  have hreindex (N : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam n / n := by
    conv_rhs => rw [show N + 2 = (N + 1) + 1 by omega, Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp [WeilOneSided.coneDeviation]
  exact (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp (hdev'.congr hreindex)

# C30 — zero-variance rigidity (OPEN)

Cycle30, 2026-10-08. Verdict: SURVIVES PRELIMINARY ATTACK; no paper proof,
no Lean assertion, independent novelty unestablished.

Given the exact internal and external frontier, what would a Fields
Medal-winning mathematician conjecture? The natural next stronger source
law is that nonrigidity cannot hide entirely in a zero logarithmic-density
coefficient defect.

Let hW be any specified WeilPositiveFull lambda, a_n=sourceCoeff lambda n,
beta=sourceCompletion hW 1. The existing unconditional ForwardVariance
module supplies the unique finite V>=0 with

    (sum_(1<=n<=N) |a_n-beta|^2/n) / log N -> V.

C30 states, with no extra source hypothesis:

    [lambda(n)=Lambda(n) for all n>=2 and RH]
       OR
    [the actual centered logarithmic variance V is strictly positive].

Equivalently, V=0 forces arithmetic rigidity. The rigid case gives V=0.
This is weaker as a producer obligation than proving C28, but stronger
than the existing dichotomy obtained by detecting a single nonzero
coefficient: that dichotomy allows a nonrigid zero-variance branch with
physical energy only of order T. C30 would eliminate that branch. With
T29, every nonrigid actual source would then have centered physical energy
of order at least T log T, so o(T log T) would already force rigidity.
Neither C30 nor the source o(T log T) estimate is supplied here.

## Attempt to kill it

1. Generic pole-free continuation and Gaussian coefficient recovery are
insufficient. The ordinary Dirichlet function zeta(s)+2^(-s) has residue1
and one nonzero centered coefficient, hence centered harmonic variance0.
It is not asserted to be a full-positive source. It kills only the
proposed deduction from pole-free centering and coefficient recovery.

2. The actual coprime covariance budget implies, when V=0, that every
finite coprime-mask residue equals beta times its ordinary density. It
does not by itself identify individual coefficients: a singleton integer
has zero logarithmic density. Passing from these residues to a pointwise
coefficient identity requires an additional source argument.

3. Existing LocalPolynomialModels proves zero valuation variance iff the
normalized local polynomial is1. This is a finite local model result,
not a representation theorem for arbitrary full-positive sources.
Neither Euler multiplicativity nor a finite-prime factorization is
available to insert as a premise.

4. The September2026 Hardy embedding preprint controls a different
coefficient norm, as recorded in CENTERED-PHASE-ENERGY.md. It does not
supply the missing coefficient faithfulness or C30.

[OPEN CORE] Show that the full-positive logarithmic convolution and
actual valuation/coprime residue laws make zero harmonic variance
faithful to every positive-index coefficient, or construct an actual
nonrigid full-positive source invisible to all these finite residues.
The two possibilities must remain distinct. Failure of a mask argument
would not disprove C30.

Next audit the exact valuation residue producer and its infinite-prime
tail obligations. Do not write a receiver assuming coefficient
faithfulness, and do not replace the common-full-measure WP04 target by
this conjecture. Continue finishing T28's actual coefficient/Bessel
obstruction while testing this source law.

every one-prime normalized residue sequence sums to1, has geometric
decay, and gives a holomorphic generating function on |z|<sqrt(p).

that theorem. In particular, one-prime marginals do not determine joint
composite coefficients. Even after obtaining every finite joint marginal,
the limit exhausting primes would need a uniform tail theorem. This is
the next specific source obligation to attack.

weight lands the cubic Hellinger codiagonal.

/-- Centered affine coordinate carrying `s` to the XiC spectral plane. -/
def xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate (s : ℂ) : ℂ := -I * (s - 1 / 2)

theorem half_add_xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate_mul_I (s : ℂ) :
    1 / 2 + xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate s * I = s := by
  rw [xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate]
  ring_nf
  rw [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

/-- FE reflection becomes centered complex conjugation. -/
theorem xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate_star (t : ℂ) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate t) =
      xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate (1 - star t) := by
  rw [xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate, xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate]
  change (starRingEnd ℂ) (-I * (t - 1 / 2)) = _
  simp
  rw [map_ofNat (starRingEnd ℂ) 2]
  ring

    1 / 2 + (starRingEnd ℂ) (xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate t) * I =

  rw [xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate_star,
    half_add_xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate_mul_I]

    xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate s -

      -I * (s + star t - 1) := by
  rw [xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate]
  change _ - (starRingEnd ℂ) (-I * (t - 1 / 2)) = _
  simp
  rw [map_ofNat (starRingEnd ℂ) 2]
  ring

    (hs : XiC (xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate s) ≠ 0)
    (ht : XiC ((starRingEnd ℂ) (xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate t)) ≠ 0)
    (hsep : xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate s ≠
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate t)) :
    xiWardCubicReflectionLoewnerKernel s t =
      xiWeilPolarization
        (xiWeilCauchyTest (xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate s))
        (xiWeilCauchyTest (xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate t)) := by
  rw [xiWeilPolarization_cauchy_eq_relativeResolvent_dividedDifference

  rw [← logDeriv_XiC_eq_relativeResolventTrace hs]

  rw [logDeriv_XiC_eq_mul_I_logDeriv_xi,

    half_add_xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate_mul_I,
    half_add_star_xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate_mul_I]
  rw [logDeriv_xi_reciprocity]
  rw [show logDeriv xi (star t) = star (logDeriv xi t) by

  rw [xiWardCubicReflectionLoewnerKernel,
    xiWardCubicCenteredCoordinate_sub_star]
  field_simp [sub_ne_zero.mpr hsep]
  ring

private theorem sum_Icc_one_eq_range {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (f : ℕ → A) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + 1) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]

/-- The two existing definitions use exactly the same truncated logarithm. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) :
    forwardCoeff lam = WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff lam := by
  unfold forwardCoeff WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff
  congr 1
  funext n
  simp only [logZetaCoeff, IntegerMassRigidity.lamLog]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.ofReal_div]

/-- Ordinary harmonic convergence after centering at the literal pole residue. -/
theorem exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ L : ℂ, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      (forwardCoeff lam n - WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1) / n)
        atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := WeilWorkSettledPhase.centered_forward_dirichletConvergesAt
    hW (s := 1) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨L, hL.congr fun N => ?_⟩
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  simp [dirichletPartialSum, Complex.cpow_neg_one, forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, div_eq_mul_inv]

/-- The harmonic weight has leading coefficient one. -/
theorem tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (1 : ℝ) / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log.div_atTop hlog).add_const 1
  simp only [zero_add] at ht
  refine ht.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hlog.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with N hN
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  have hh : (harmonic N : ℝ) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) := by
    simp [harmonic, one_div]
  rw [hh]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  field_simp
  ring

private theorem mean_of_centered {f : ℕ → ℝ} {B L : ℝ}
    (h : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (f n - B) / n)
      atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 B) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (h.div_atTop hlog).add (tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log.const_mul B)
  simp only [mul_one, zero_add] at ht
  apply ht.congr
  intro N
  simp only [sub_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [mul_one_div]
  ring

/-- Both coordinates of the actual logarithmic first mean equal the residue. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_harmonic_mean {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).re / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).re) ∧
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).im / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).im) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit hW
  constructor
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.re)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.re_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.sub_re] using ht
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.im)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.im_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.sub_im] using ht

/-- Integer mode centered on the odd-dimensional packet `{-N,...,N}`. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredMode (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℤ :=
  (i.val : ℤ) - N

/-- The clock of the published finite matrix.  It is dimensionless, exactly as the denominator
`i-j` in CCM equation (5.2). -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredClock (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  ccmPublishedCenteredMode N i

/-- Physical Fourier frequency `πn/a = 2πn/L`, where `L=2a`. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi * ccmPublishedCenteredClock N i / a

/-- Actual published off-diagonal source coordinate at a centered mode. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredSource (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  -(1 / Real.pi) *
    ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilPairing a
      (fun h => Real.sin (ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i * h))

/-- Actual published diagonal coordinate: the restricted Weil value of
`2(1-h/(2a)) cos(πnh/a)`. -/
def ccmPublishedCenteredDiagonal (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilPairing a
    (fun h =>
      2 * (1 - h / (2 * a)) *
        Real.cos (ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i * h))

/-- The exact finite restricted-Weil matrix in the centered Fourier packet at physical `a > 0`,
with a totalized algebraic extension to every real `a`. -/
def ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    Matrix (Fin (2 * N + 1)) (Fin (2 * N + 1)) ℝ :=
  ccmDividedDifferenceMatrix
    (ccmPublishedCenteredClock N)
    (ccmPublishedCenteredSource a N)
    (ccmPublishedCenteredDiagonal a N)

/-- Source-lock identification with the pre-existing published coefficient. -/
theorem ccmPublishedCenteredSource_eq_sourceSineCoefficient
    (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) :
    ccmPublishedCenteredSource a N i =
      ccmPublishedSourceSineCoefficient a
        (ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i) := by
  exact neg_inv_pi_mul_ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilPairing_sine _ _

/-- Diagonal entries are literal tent--cosine restricted-Weil values. -/
theorem ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix_apply_self
    (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) :
    ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix a N i i =
      ccmPublishedCenteredDiagonal a N i := by
  simp [ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix, ccmDividedDifferenceMatrix]

/-- Off-diagonal entries are literal divided differences of the published source coordinate. -/
theorem ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix_apply_of_ne
    (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) {i j : Fin (2 * N + 1)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix a N i j =
      (ccmPublishedCenteredSource a N i -
          ccmPublishedCenteredSource a N j) /
        (ccmPublishedCenteredClock N i -
          ccmPublishedCenteredClock N j) := by
  simp [ccmPublishedRestrictedWeilMatrix, ccmDividedDifferenceMatrix, hij]

/-- Reversal of the finite packet is integer negation of its centered mode. -/
theorem ccmPublishedCenteredMode_rev (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) :
    ccmPublishedCenteredMode N (Fin.revPerm i) =
      -ccmPublishedCenteredMode N i := by
  simp only [ccmPublishedCenteredMode, Fin.revPerm_apply, Fin.val_rev]
  omega

/-- The centered real clock is reflection-odd. -/
theorem ccmPublishedCenteredClock_rev (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) :
    ccmPublishedCenteredClock N (Fin.revPerm i) =
      -ccmPublishedCenteredClock N i := by
  rw [ccmPublishedCenteredClock, ccmPublishedCenteredClock,
    ccmPublishedCenteredMode_rev]
  exact_mod_cast rfl

/-- The centered clock is injective. -/
theorem ccmPublishedCenteredClock_injective (N : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (ccmPublishedCenteredClock N) := by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  unfold ccmPublishedCenteredClock at hij
  have hz : ccmPublishedCenteredMode N i = ccmPublishedCenteredMode N j := by
    exact_mod_cast hij
  unfold ccmPublishedCenteredMode at hz
  omega

/-- Physical frequency is reflection-odd. -/
theorem ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency_rev
    (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) :
    ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N (Fin.revPerm i) =
      -ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i := by
  unfold ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency
  rw [ccmPublishedCenteredClock_rev]
  ring

/-- The actual published source vector is reflection-odd. -/
theorem ccmPublishedCenteredSource_rev
    (a : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * N + 1)) :
    ccmPublishedCenteredSource a N (Fin.revPerm i) =
      -ccmPublishedCenteredSource a N i := by
  unfold ccmPublishedCenteredSource
  rw [ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency_rev]
  have hsin :
      (fun h : ℝ => Real.sin (-ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i * h)) =
        fun h : ℝ => -Real.sin (ccmPublishedCenteredFrequency a N i * h) := by

/-!
# Short-interval consequences of full-cone Weil positivity

With `herglotzWeilPositive_of_weilPositiveFull`, the short-interval theorems proved for
Herglotz–Weil-positive systems hold on the whole full Weil cone, with no further hypothesis.

* `exists_weight_ne_zero_mem_Ioo_of_weilPositiveFull`: the support of every full-cone
  Weil-positive system meets every interval `(x, x + x^{1/2+ε})` with `x` large.
* `volume_primeGapStarts_le_of_weilPositiveFull`: a prime-supported full-cone Weil-positive
  system forces primes in all windows `(e^u, e^u(1 + X^{ε−1}))`, `u ∈ [log X, log 2X]`, outside a
  set of measure `O(X^{−ε/2})`.
-/

open Complex MeasureTheory Set

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower.WeilSpectral

/-- **Short intervals meet the support of every Weil-positive system.** -/
theorem exists_weight_ne_zero_mem_Ioo_of_weilPositiveFull {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x₀, ∃ n : ℕ, x < n ∧ (n : ℝ) < x + x ^ (1 / 2 + ε) ∧ 2 ≤ n ∧ lam n ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := exists_weight_ne_zero_mem_Ioo_of_zetaWeilPositive
    (herglotzWeilPositive_of_weilPositiveFull hW) hε
  refine ⟨x₀, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hx₀ x hx
  split_ifs at h3 with hn
  · exact ⟨n, h1, h2, hn, h3⟩
  · exact absurd rfl h3

/-- **Prime-supported Weil-positive systems force primes in almost all short windows.** -/
theorem volume_primeGapStarts_le_of_weilPositiveFull {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (hsupp : ∀ n : ℕ, lam n ≠ 0 → n.Prime) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ X : ℝ, 1 ≤ X →
      volume {u : ℝ | u ∈ Icc (Real.log X) (Real.log (2 * X)) ∧
        ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → Real.exp u < p → (p : ℝ) < Real.exp u + Real.exp u * X ^ (ε - 1) →
          False}
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * X ^ (-(ε / 2))) := by
  refine volume_primeGapStarts_le_of_zetaWeilPositive (herglotzWeilPositive_of_weilPositiveFull hW)
    (fun n hn => ?_) hε hε1
  split_ifs at hn with h
  · exact hsupp n hn
  · exact absurd rfl hn

end RHTower.WeilSpectral

/-- Full-cone Weil-positive weights have `Σ |lam(n) − Λ(n)| n^{−2} < ∞`. -/
theorem summable_sub_vonMangoldt_div_sq {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Summable fun n : ℕ => |lam n - ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n| / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 :=

/-- **Supporting hyperplane, unconditional.** Every Weil-positive `lam` satisfies
`Σ_{n ≥ 2} lam(n) n^{−1/2}(K(log n) + K(−log n)) ≤ Σ_{n ≥ 2} Λ(n) n^{−1/2}(K(log n) + K(−log n))`,

/-- **`Λ` is an exposed point of the full Weil cone.** Every Weil-positive `lam` has
`ℓ(lam − Λ) ≤ 0`, with equality only if `lam = Λ` on `n ≥ 2`. The exposing functional `ℓ` has
the strictly positive kernel `Φ ⋆ Φ̃`. No summability hypothesis: Weil positivity bounds
`|lam(n)| ≤ √n (log n + C₀)`. -/
theorem weilFullCone_exposed_at_vonMangoldt {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    atomPairing (fun n => lam n - ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) riemannKernelAutocorr ≤ 0 ∧
      (atomPairing (fun n => lam n - ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) riemannKernelAutocorr = 0 →
        ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) :=
  ⟨atomPairing_riemannKernelAutocorr_nonpos hW (summable_sub_vonMangoldt_div_sq hW),
    eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_atomPairing_eq_zero hW (summable_sub_vonMangoldt_div_sq hW)⟩

/-- **`Λ` is an extreme point of the full Weil cone**, with no hypothesis on `w`: if `Λ + w` and
`Λ − w` are both Weil-positive, then `w(n) = 0` for all `n ≥ 2`. -/
theorem weilFullCone_extreme_at_vonMangoldt {w : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hp : WeilPositiveFull fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) + w n)
    (hm : WeilPositiveFull fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) - w n) :
    ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → w n = 0 := by
  have hw2 := summable_sub_vonMangoldt_div_sq hp
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at hw2
  exact eq_zero_of_weilPositiveFull_add_of_sub hw2 hp hm

/-! ## RH criteria -/

/-- Under RH the zero side is `Σ m_ρ |f̂(γ_ρ)|² ≥ 0` for every test, so `Λ` is Weil-positive in the
full cone. -/
theorem weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldt_of_riemannHypothesis (hRH : RiemannHypothesis) :
    WeilPositiveFull fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) := by
  intro f hf hfc
  rw [← zeta_W_eq_weilFullFunctional hf hfc]
  have hkd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (EF.weilTest f f) := EF.weilTest_contDiff hf hf.continuous hfc
  have hkc : HasCompactSupport (EF.weilTest f f) := EF.weilTest_hasCompactSupport hfc hfc
  obtain ⟨hsum, -⟩ := WeilEF.EF_lit_zetaZeroConfig _ hkd hkc
  have hfac := EF.paperFT_weilTest hf.continuous hf.continuous hfc hfc
  have hterm : (fun ρ : zetaZeroConfig.carrier =>
      (zetaZeroConfig.mult ρ : ℂ) * paperFT (EF.weilTest f f) (gammaOf ρ)) =
      fun ρ : zetaZeroConfig.carrier => zetaZeroConfig.Wsummand f f ρ := by
    ext ρ; simp only [ZeroConfig.Wsummand, hfac, mul_assoc]
  rw [hterm] at hsum
  rw [ZeroConfig.W, Complex.re_tsum hsum]
  refine tsum_nonneg fun ρ => ?_
  have hre : (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2 := Zeta23.RH_implies_on_line hRH ρ.2
  have hreal : conj (gammaOf (ρ : ℂ)) = gammaOf ρ := by
    apply Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr
    rw [WeilEF.gammaOf_im, hre]; ring
  simp only [ZeroConfig.Wsummand, hreal]
  rw [mul_assoc, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
  positivity

/-- **Weil's criterion in the full cone.** -/

    rw [weilContinuation_eq hW hs, weilFunction, zetaArchimedeanDatum]
    rfl

/-- **Prime-supported Weil-positive systems force primes in short intervals.**  If `lam` is
full-cone Weil-positive and vanishes off the primes, then every interval `(x, x + x^{1/2+ε})`
with `x` large contains a prime. -/
theorem exists_prime_mem_Ioo_of_weilPositiveFull {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (hsupp : ∀ n : ℕ, lam n ≠ 0 → n.Prime) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x₀, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ x < p ∧ (p : ℝ) < x + x ^ (1 / 2 + ε) := by
  refine exists_prime_mem_Ioo_of_zetaWeilPositive (herglotzWeilPositive_of_weilPositiveFull hW)
    (fun n hn => ?_) hε
  split_ifs at hn with h
  · exact hsupp n hn
  · exact absurd rfl hn

end RHTower.WeilSpectral

/-!
# Removing primes destroys Weil positivity

For a set `R` of primes, let `Λ_R(n) = Λ(n)` unless `n` is a power of a prime in `R`, and
`Λ_R(n) = 0` otherwise: the von Mangoldt function of `ζ(s) ∏_{p ∈ R}(1 - p^{-s})`.  Removing finitely
many Euler factors does not move the zeros of `ζ` in the critical strip (the new zeros lie on
`Re s = 0`), but it destroys Weil positivity for the archimedean datum of `ζ`, unconditionally:
`Λ_R ≤ Λ`, and a full-cone Weil-positive minorant of `Λ` equals `Λ`
(`eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_le`).
-/

namespace RHTower
namespace RemovedPrimes

open ArithmeticFunction

/-- The von Mangoldt function with the powers of the primes in `R` removed. -/
noncomputable def vonMangoldtWithout (R : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Set.indicator {m | ¬ ∃ p ∈ R, ∃ k, m = p ^ k} (fun m => (vonMangoldt m : ℝ)) n

theorem vonMangoldtWithout_le (R : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    vonMangoldtWithout R n ≤ (vonMangoldt n : ℝ) :=
  Set.indicator_le_self' (fun _ _ => vonMangoldt_nonneg) n

/-- **Removing any prime destroys Weil positivity.**  If `R` contains a prime, then the von Mangoldt
function with the powers of the primes of `R` removed is not full-cone Weil-positive. -/
theorem not_weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldtWithout {R : Set ℕ} {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpR : p ∈ R) :
    ¬ WeilPositiveFull (vonMangoldtWithout R) := by
  intro hW
  have h := eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_le hW fun n _ => vonMangoldtWithout_le R n
  have hp2 := h p hp.two_le
  have hmem : p ∉ {m : ℕ | ¬ ∃ q ∈ R, ∃ k, m = q ^ k} := by
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not]
    exact ⟨p, hpR, 1, (pow_one p).symm⟩
  have h0 : vonMangoldtWithout R p = 0 := Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem _
  rw [h0, vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp] at hp2
  exact (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt)).ne' hp2.symm

/-- In particular, the von Mangoldt function of `(1 - 2^{-s}) ζ(s)` (the prime `2` removed) is not
full-cone Weil-positive. -/
theorem not_weilPositiveFull_without_two :
    ¬ WeilPositiveFull (vonMangoldtWithout {2}) :=
  not_weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldtWithout Nat.prime_two rfl

end RemovedPrimes
end RHTower

angoldt_add_eq_zero_of_symbol (continuous_regularSymbol hR)
    (abs_regularSymbol_le hEb) (fun _ _ _ hf hfs => regular_symbol_identity hR hf hfs)
    hW hn

/-- The sequence `Λ + w`. -/
def addVonMangoldt (w : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n + w n

/-- **Full-cone form.** -/
theorem eq_zero_of_weilPositiveFull_add (hR : RegularDeviation w E)
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull (addVonMangoldt w)) (n : ℕ) : w n = 0 :=
  eq_zero_of_weilPositive_add hR (RHTower.weilPositive_of_weilPositiveFull hW) n

/-- **A regular deviation of a full-cone Weil-positive completion forces RH.** -/
theorem riemannHypothesis_of_weilPositiveFull_add (hR : RegularDeviation w E)
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull (addVonMangoldt w)) : RiemannHypothesis := by
  have h : addVonMangoldt w = fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) :=
    funext fun n => by simp [addVonMangoldt, eq_zero_of_weilPositiveFull_add hR hW n]
  rw [h] at hW
  exact RHTower.riemannHypothesis_iff_weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldt.mpr hW

end
